acceptance.given: A fresh checkout is available and result-determining inputs have not yet been bound into a Current Snapshot.

oracle.expected: Before replay, a typed immutable manifest binds the Git baseline, Skill-input v2 selection and content, code, fixtures, contracts, Consumers, tests, targets, validators, dependencies, sources, evidence, and any versioned normalization policy.
forbidden: A partial snapshot omits a result-determining input.
Mutable, unbound, or historical-only inputs are accepted as pinned current inputs.
oracle.observable: The Current Snapshot manifest and its verification report enumerate every required input category with canonical immutable identities before replay.

acceptance.then: The semantic result is bound only to a complete, verified Current Snapshot.
acceptance.when: The snapshot verifier prepares a semantic reconstruction from the fresh checkout and pinned inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise snapshot verification with a required result-determining input omitted or mutable and observe closed invalidation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind and verify a complete typed Current Snapshot before semantic reconstruction; every result-determining input must have a canonical immutable identity.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Snapshot additions preserve existing historical records; missing or changed bound inputs invalidate dependent results rather than rewriting evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unbound fresh-checkout inputs -> complete verified Current Snapshot binding.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Snapshot verification reports every required result-determining category bound immutably before replay; omission or mutability makes reconstruction ineligible.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation is presented with required matrix evidence missing.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid despite missing matrix evidence.
Missing matrix evidence is treated as a successful or accepted aggregate.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation result contains an invalid terminal decision attributable to the missing matrix-evidence check.

acceptance.then: Acceptance is blocked because matrix evidence is incomplete.
acceptance.when: Aggregate evaluation validates the required matrix evidence set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate an aggregate missing required matrix evidence and require its invalid terminal decision.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make aggregate evaluation reject acceptance whenever any required matrix evidence is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Aggregate result compatibility is preserved by representing absent required matrix evidence as an invalid result, never as success.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate with missing required matrix evidence -> invalid, non-acceptable aggregate.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Any missing required matrix evidence produces an invalid aggregate that cannot be accepted.

acceptance.given: Historical tracked membership exists before repair work begins.

oracle.expected: A before-and-after comparison shows identical historical tracked membership.
oracle.observable: The historical-membership comparison generated during repair validation reports no added, removed, or altered tracked members.

acceptance.when: Repair validation compares frozen historical tracked membership with its pre-repair baseline.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Introduce a membership difference in the comparison input and require the historical-integrity check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify the frozen historical tracked-membership set against its pre-repair baseline and reject any addition, removal, or alteration.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Historical membership remains immutable; repair records are append-only and historical evidence remains non-authorizing.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing frozen historical membership -> identical membership after repair validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The comparison finds no added, removed, or altered historical tracked member; any difference rejects the repair.

acceptance.given: An Exact Cover graph contains behavioral Atomic Obligations and their proposed fault witnesses.

oracle.expected: Every behavioral Atomic Obligation maps to its own independently observable fault witness.
forbidden: A behavioral obligation without an observable fault witness.
Reusing a fault witness without independently observing the behavioral obligation.
oracle.observable: Exact-Cover validation reports a distinct independently observable witness binding for each behavioral Atomic Obligation.

acceptance.then: Behavioral Exact-Cover obligations have independent fault witnesses.
acceptance.when: The Exact Cover graph is constructed or validated before acceptance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the behavioral Exact-Cover validator with a behavioral obligation lacking an independently observed fault witness and require the fault-witness check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each behavioral Atomic Obligation to retain a separately observable independent fault witness in Exact Cover validation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Exact-Cover validation remains backward-compatible by rejecting incomplete behavioral witness mappings without changing historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Behavioral obligations with unverified or reused witnesses -> independently witnessed behavioral Exact Cover.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact-Cover validation accepts a behavioral obligation only when its fault witness is independently observable; a missing or reused-unobserved witness fails.
